methodology: 50 concurrent connections, 30s total duration, abrupt container termination (docker stop) at t=10s

before.label: Before (Default Spring Cloud Cache Settings: 30s Registry Fetch + 35s LoadBalancer TTL, No Retry)
before.analysis: With default 30s/35s cache settings, the gateway dispatched 1/3 of all requests to the dead container socket for ~34 seconds, causing 894 dropped connections (31.48% error rate) and a 34-second MTTR.

after.label: After (Tuned 5s Registry Fetch + 5s LoadBalancer TTL)

cacheSettings.gatewayRetryConfig: Retry filter enabled for idempotent GETs (series: 5xx, methods: GET, retries: 2)

after.analysis: Under tuned 5s cache settings, connection resets only occurred during the 5.5s window before LoadBalancer cache eviction. All subsequent traffic automatically routed to the remaining 2 healthy instances.
